standard.summary: 训练时采样的最大时间步（不包含）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The largest timestep sampled during training (exclusive).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练时采样的最大时间步（不包含）。例如细节修复 LoRA 可设置 300 只影响后期细节。

advanced_en.principle: Maximum timestep sampled during training (exclusive). E.g. a detail-repair LoRA can set 300 to affect only late-stage details.
